earnings.title: UBIQUITI INC. REPORTS FIRST QUARTER FISCAL 2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS
highlights: The Company's Board of Directors declared a $1.00 per share cash dividend payable on November 23, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 16, 2026.

items.heading: We have limited visibility into future sales as a result of our reliance on distributors, which may increase volatility in our results and makes it difficult to forecast our future results of operations.
